shard1.selection: last block at or before requested cutoff

valuation.note: Used for historical reporting only; public eligibility is ONE-denominated.

withheld_fields: exchange wallet inventories, destinations, memos, and address outcomes

wone_overlay.holder_source: cutoff-pinned archival-node event replay reconciled to totalSupply and native reserve
wone_overlay.qualified_holder_treatment: wallet delivery for ordinary-threshold rows plus every confirmed exchange wallet delivered manually from the 2050 supply reserve, with matching reserve source classified as redistributed
wone_overlay.remainder_treatment: not issued; retained in the 2050 premint reserve

selected_policy.threshold_timing: evaluate snapshot qualification before deductions or routing
selected_policy.initial_stage: positive eligible wallets with indexed activity in the six calendar months before cutoff
selected_policy.exchange_manual_stage: every positive native ONE, WONE, and delegated entitlement in a confirmed exchange inventory is excluded from the airdrop and delivered manually from the 2050 supply reserve to the exchange's confirmed destination(s); no individual threshold or activity gate; issuance_treatment manual_from_reserve; delegated principal released from the validator vaults
selected_policy.code_bearing_accounts: preliminary review; verified validator-wrapper accounts remain key-controlled wallets
selected_policy.reviewed_contracts: multisig, LayerZero collateral, and 1wallet allocations are next stage; SmartVault and other reviewed genuine-contract allocations are not issued
selected_policy.stage_and_treatment: migration stage, issuance treatment, account classification, and destination readiness are separate fields

exchange_delivery_overlay.delivery: manual_from_reserve for every exchange: the complete cutoff entitlement (native ONE, WONE, delegated principal) is delivered by hand from the year 2050 supply reserve and never enters the airdrop

destination_modes.aggregate: every component to one confirmed destination
destination_modes.aggregate_split: wallet components (liquid, pending cross-shard, WONE) to a wallet destination and staking components (delegated principal, pending undelegation, unclaimed reward) to a staking destination; roles are named explicitly in the destination file
destination_modes.same_address: each source wallet receives its own entitlement at its own address
destination_modes.tiered: wallets meeting the initial distribution criteria (inclusive threshold and six-month indexed activity) receive their entitlement at their own addresses; every other wallet is aggregated to the confirmed destination

exchange_delivery_overlay.threshold_overlap: removed from implicit automatic same-address delivery only; not an entitlement calculation
exchange_delivery_overlay.submitted_balance_role: reconciliation evidence only; never a replacement for cutoff chain accounting

excluded_uncertainty.reason: Destination spent status on retired shards 2 and 3 is not provable from the active shard databases; excluded to avoid double counting.

methods: exchange normalization, overlap, signature, and route closure checks
